_doc: Recorded sound effects for Wobblers, made with the ElevenLabs sound-generation API (generate.py). name: the sound id src/audio.js plays (one-shots replace the synthesised sound of the same name; loops are ambient beds placed with audio.ambientSpot). n: variants; dur: requested seconds; loop: a seamless ambient loop; level: playback gain.
style: Cheerful, cartoony video game sound effect for a silly physics sandbox with wobbly bean people, clean, no music unless asked.

sounds.name: punch
sounds.prompt: Soft cartoon punch hitting a squishy rubber toy, comedic bop

sounds.name: thud
sounds.prompt: Wobbly rubber body flopping onto the ground, soft comedic thud

sounds.name: land
sounds.prompt: Small feet landing on the ground after a jump, soft squishy pat

sounds.name: splash
sounds.prompt: Cartoon character splashing into a swimming pool, playful water splash

sounds.name: boing
sounds.prompt: Springy cartoon boing of bouncing on a trampoline

sounds.name: swish
sounds.prompt: Quick whoosh of a wobbly arm swinging a punch through the air

sounds.name: door
sounds.prompt: Wooden house door swinging open with a short creak and soft knock

sounds.name: wheee
sounds.prompt: Happy cartoon character shouting wheee while sliding down a slide, playful voice, no words

sounds.name: ko
sounds.prompt: Cartoon bonk on the head followed by a dizzy slide whistle down and twinkling stars

sounds.name: bark
sounds.prompt: A small friendly dog barking once, cute

sounds.name: ride_screams
sounds.prompt: Amusement park ride: a group of happy riders screaming and laughing as a roller coaster drops and swoops past, distant rattle of the track, excited cheers

sounds.name: fair_crowd
sounds.prompt: Busy autumn county fair: crowd of teenagers and families chatting and laughing outdoors, distant ride machinery hum and happy screams, faint carnival game bells, no music

sounds.name: park_crowd
sounds.prompt: Small funfair in a town park: people chatting and laughing, children giggling, a carousel turning, distant happy screams from rides, no music

sounds.name: city_street
sounds.prompt: Cheerful cartoon city street: traffic passing by, occasional friendly car horns, pedestrians chatting, a bus pulling away, pigeons, no music

sounds.name: plaza_chatter
sounds.prompt: Town square on a sunny day: relaxed crowd chatter and laughter, footsteps, a water fountain splashing, birds, no music

sounds.name: arcade_room
sounds.prompt: Retro video arcade room: many old arcade machines beeping and blooping, chiptune jingles, buttons clicking, kids cheering, muffled
